'''Gorgo''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]]. He created images of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] by exposing prothium gas to the world, resulting in "frozen" images of Nal Hutta from Gorgo's time. His artwork was extremely rare. [[Rokko]] the Hutt owned the last pieces of his art. Gorgo died some centuries ago before [[Rokko]] was born.
